name: EnterpriseContactEdit

parameters.help_en: The ID of the contact to modify. You can invoke the EnterpriseContactQueryPageList operation to perform a paged query of account contact information
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改的联系人的ID。可调用EnterpriseContactQueryPageList分页查询账号联系人信息
parameters.name: contact_id

parameters.help_en: The email address of the contact
parameters.name: contact_email

parameters.help_en: The mobile phone number of the contact
parameters.name: contact_mobile

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the contact is a public contact. This operation sets this parameter to true by default
parameters.help_zh: 是否公共联系人。当前接口默认set true
parameters.name: shared_contact

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to asynchronously verify the email address. Set this parameter to true for API calls. Otherwise, the verification code is synchronously and strictly verified. Call SendAsyncEmailCaptcha to send a verification link
parameters.help_zh: 是否异步校验邮箱。api调用需要为true。否则将同步强校验验证码。通过接口SendAsyncEmailCaptcha发送验证链接
parameters.name: async_email_verify

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to asynchronously verify the mobile phone number. Set this parameter to true for API calls. Otherwise, the verification code is synchronously and strictly verified. Call SendAsyncMobileCaptcha to send a verification link
parameters.help_zh: 是否异步校验手机号。api调用需要为true。否则将同步强校验验证码。通过接口SendAsyncMobileCaptcha发送验证链接
parameters.name: async_mobile_verify

parameters.help_en: The ID of the enterprise to which you have switched
